purpose: Canonical standalone software baseline for silicon-spin circuit, pulse, profile-provenance, and ideal-statevector simulation work.

legacy_source.relationship: The baseline is an orphan branch that preserves only the MIT license from the recorded legacy source revision. It is not a historical-tree refactor.

permitted: The branch defines a standalone, ML-free software baseline.
The included tests exercise the declared circuit, pulse, profile, and ideal-statevector interfaces.
Built-in profile data are literature-parameterised metadata.

standards_status.openqasm: A deliberately small, documented OpenQASM 3-compatible input subset is implemented.
standards_status.openpulse: A local pulse-schedule schema is implemented; it is not a full OpenPulse implementation.
standards_status.third_party_sdk_plugins: Deferred until separately implemented and tested.
